I'm in my 47th year in steel erection and fabrication. In my experience nobody wants to do manual labor or even skilled LABOR anymore.
Everybody wants to work remote, get top dollar with zero experience, show up when they want or just be an internet influencer.
Everybody says..pay them what they are worth. I don't disagree but a company has to be competitive, steel erection & fab is a very competetive business.
You would have to get every fabricator /erector to agree to up their wages at the same time but it doesn't work that way.
In Colorado we have to compete against fabricators from out of state with lower wages and cost of living.
It's just not as simple as raising wages, if you do you can easily price yourself out of the market.
My advice to someone that wants to weld, go straight to aerospace and learn the most advance welding processes out there.
